# New-ZbxMap

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a network map.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxMap [[-Name] <string>] [[-Width] <int>] [-Private <bool>] [-ShowSuppressed <bool>] [-ExpandProblem <ZabbixMapExpandProblem>] [-Shape <ZabbixMapShapeRequest[]>] [-Line <ZabbixMapLineRequest[]>] [-Element <ZabbixMapElementRequest[]>] [-User <ZabbixMapUserRequest[]>] [-UserGroup <ZabbixMapUserGroupRequest[]>] [-Height <int>] [-BackgroundScale <ZabbixMapBackgroundScale>] [-ShowElementLabel <ZabbixMapShowElementLabel>] [-ShowLinkLabel <ZabbixMapShowElementLabel>] [-Link <ZabbixMapLinkRequest[]>] [-BackgroundId <ulong>] [-LabelType <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelLocation <ZabbixMapLabelLocation>] [-Highlight <bool>] [-MarkElements <int>] [-ShowUnacknowledged <ZabbixMapShowUnacknowledged>] [-GridSize <int>] [-GridShow <bool>] [-GridAlign <bool>] [-LabelFormat <bool>] [-LabelTypeHost <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeHostGroup <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeTrigger <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeMap <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelTypeImage <ZabbixMapLabelType>] [-LabelStringHost <string>] [-LabelStringHostGroup <string>] [-LabelStringTrigger <string>] [-LabelStringMap <string>] [-LabelStringImage <string>] [-IconMapId <ulong>] [-ExpandMacros <bool>] [-SeverityMin <ZabbixSeverity>] [-UserId <ulong>] [-Url <ZabbixMapUrlRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A network map draws hosts, host groups, triggers and other maps as icons joined by links, colored by the problems behind them. The New-ZbxMap cmdlet sends map.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new network map back with map.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -Width and -Height; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a network map

```powershell
New-ZbxMap -Name 'Office map' -Width 800 -Height 600
```

Creates a network map named Office map. The command writes the new network map, read back from the server.
